mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_refund ( refund_no, out_trade_no, user_id, refund_amount_vnd, refund_xu, type, status, reason, original_ledger_transaction_id, hold_ledger_transaction_id, reversal_ledger_transaction_id, provider_reference, idempotency_key, processed_by, processed_at, version ) VALUES ( #{refundNo}, #{outTradeNo}, #{userId}, #{refundAmountVnd}, #{refundXu}, #{type}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{originalLedgerTransactionId}, #{holdLedgerTransactionId}, #{reversalLedgerTransactionId}, #{providerReference}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{processedBy}, #{processedAt}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_refund WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE order_refund SET status = #{nextStatus}, hold_ledger_transaction_id = COALESCE(#{holdLedgerTransactionId}, hold_ledger_transaction_id), reversal_ledger_transaction_id = #{reversalLedgerTransactionId}, provider_reference = COALESCE(#{providerReference}, provider_reference), processed_by = #{processedBy}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), reason = COALESCE(#{reason}, reason), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_refund_audit (refund_id, refund_no, event_type, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, reason) VALUES (#{refundId}, #{refundNo}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{reason})
